sourceDescription: Edit Project source files. Save a version to preview; publish it separately.
sourceConflict: The file or version changed, or saving failed. Your draft is retained. Reopen to load the current version before merging.
sourceError: Source files could not be loaded.
subtitle: Build in chat. Preview and publish here.
emptyDescription: Describe your site in the chat. Saved versions appear here for review.
name: Site name
prompt: What would you like to build?
createDescription: Create a project and send your brief to the assistant in the left chat.
publicWarning: Anyone who receives this link can open the published version.
publishDescription: Publish this exact saved version. Later edits remain drafts until published again.
saveHint: Ask the assistant to build the source and save a version. It will appear here automatically.
restoreDescription: Copy this version into a new saved version. The published site stays on its current version.
archiveDescription: Remove this project from the library. Existing published links are not revoked. Revoke them first if needed.
revokeDescription: The public link for this deployment will stop working.
hostingDescription: Self-contained static sites, published through Xpert Artifacts. Server functions, databases and traffic analytics are not available in this version.
error: The operation failed. Refresh and try again; check plugin configuration if it persists.
createPrompt: Build the site “{{name}}” for project {{id}}: {{prompt}}. Inspect this project first, create source files, then save a reviewable version. Do not publish yet.
improvePrompt: Continue editing site “{{name}}”, project {{id}}, based on the selected version {{version}}. Inspect the project and ask me what to change.
